title: The Prophet
author: Kahlil Gibran
summary: Before sailing home, the prophet Almustafa answers the questions of the people of Orphalese. His poetic essays cover love, marriage, children, work, joy and sorrow, freedom and death.
readIf: you like short, lyrical meditations to read slowly and revisit.
skipIf: you want argument or concrete detail, as the style is aphoristic and elevated.
